name: Spacefast
description: Publishes sites, apps and artifacts that AI agents build to a permanent URL with immutable versions and rollback, via CLI, REST API or hosted MCP.

skills.name: Publish a Site
skills.description: Publishes a folder, zip or index.html from an agent, curl or the CLI to a live URL, with no account for the first publish.

skills.name: Versions and Rollback
skills.description: Creates an immutable version on every changed publish and restores any retained version without rebuilding.

skills.name: Private Sharing and Domains
skills.description: Shares a Space privately with scoped people and links, or moves it to a custom domain with automatic SSL.

skills.name: Run Server Code
skills.description: Runs Functions workers or a TypeScript app beside the Space's own MySQL database, with crons that call your site.
